description: Add (or subtract) N Korean business days to a date, skipping weekends and public holidays — e.g. '3 business days after today' for shipping ETAs, or count business days between two dates. 영업일 기준으로 날짜를 더하거나 두 날짜 사이 영업일 수를 셉니다. Use for 납기·배송·결제 기한 계산. Needs from (default today) and either days or to.

extraHolidays.description: Additional holidays (e.g. from kr_holidays of the public-data server, or company days off)

name: kr_add_business_days
